title: 🛡️ Sentinel: Enhance maskSecrets precision and coverage
body:
This PR enhances the `maskSecrets` utility to provide better protection against credential leakage in logs and telemetry.

Key improvements:
- Added `sk-proj-` prefix detection for OpenAI Project keys.
- Refined the label-based masking (e.g., `api_key: ...`) to utilize capturing groups, ensuring that the original delimiters (`:` or `=`) and any surrounding spaces or quotes are preserved in the output. This prevents minor formatting shifts in logs while still redacting the sensitive value.
- Expanded the label-based keywords to include `passwd`.
- Synchronized these enhancements with the local `maskSecrets` implementation in `cloudflare-worker-ai-proxy/src/index.ts` to ensure consistent security across the stack.
- Updated `src/shared/utils/crypto.test.ts` with new test cases covering these improvements.

These changes follow the principle of defense in depth by providing more accurate and comprehensive redaction of sensitive data.
